title: AI reasoning transparency: restructure post-task analysis into Summary→Thought→Action and show each step to operators
goal: AutoPenBench (arxiv:2410.03225) proves that separating reasoning into three distinct steps (Summary → Thought → Action) reduces LLM hallucinations and prevents action-thought inconsistency. AegisPT's ai_agent.py currently produces a unified Observations/Hypotheses/Proposals output. The reasoning_text is stored in AgentProposal records but never shown to operators in the UI. Two changes needed: (1) Backend: restructure DeterministicPostTaskAnalysisProvider and ChatGPTOAuthPostTaskAnalysisProvider to explicitly produce and store three separate fields in AgentReasoning: summary_text (what happened in the task), thought_text (what does this mean for the engagement), and action_text (what should be done next and why). Map these to the existing observations/hypotheses/proposals structure. Store all three in AgentReasoning.metadata_json or add new columns. (2) Frontend: In Mission Control, when an AI analysis has been run for a task, show a collapsible 'AI Analysis' card below the task in the task list: Summary: [text], Reasoning: [text], Suggested Actions: [proposal list with approve/reject]. This exposes what the AI is 'thinking' and lets operators evaluate reasoning quality before approving proposals. The reasoning_text field already exists on AgentProposal — surface it.
scope: AutoPenBench paper + code audit 2026-05-03: AgentProposal.reasoning_text exists in DB (migrations/20260422_0013_ai_agent_reasoning_ledger.py) but is never rendered in UI. AutoPenBench shows that explicit Summary→Thought→Action separation improves LLM performance. Operators cannot currently evaluate AI reasoning quality.
generation_reason: AutoPenBench proves Summary→Thought→Action separation reduces hallucinations. AegisPT stores reasoning_text but never shows it. Critical for operator trust in AI proposals.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Add three reasoning fields and the UI card. Do not change proposal generation logic or approval gates.

success_criteria: AgentReasoning records store summary_text, thought_text, action_text separately.
Mission Control task list shows collapsible 'AI Analysis' card per completed task when analysis exists.
Card shows: Summary (what happened), Reasoning (what it means), Suggested Actions (proposals with approve/reject).
reasoning_text from AgentProposal is shown per proposal.
Card hidden when no analysis exists for a task.
No regression in AI agent or Mission Control E2E tests.

acceptance_criteria: AI Analysis card renders in Mission Control.
